$comment: Proposed machine-readable exact merge-artifact identity tuple for Code Governance MVP 1C. Documentation-only; defines a PRODUCT-INTERNAL representation, not a new neutral contract.

carried_by.integrity: product ExactChangeAuthorization envelope content hash + CER.content_hash + ActionGovernanceResult.fingerprint
carried_by.note: The CER has no typed field for exact SHA VALUES; values ride in the (key->value) parameter maps and are frozen into the product envelope hash. The CER names which parameter keys are permitted and which controls are required.

expected_merge_tree_digest.note: expected resulting tree; primary exact-artifact binding

expected_result_commit.note: recorded at reconciliation, not always pre-authorizable (rebase)

merge_group_sha.note: the queue-produced merge-group artifact; receives its own re-validation + ACP clearance

policy_version.note: policy_id:version; carried as VersionedRef in DecisionRecord.policy_refs / CER.policy_context

merge_commit.binding: base_sha + head_sha + merge_method + expected_merge_tree_digest -> resulting merge commit reconciled

squash.binding: base_sha + head_sha + squash + expected_resulting_tree -> resulting commit reconciled

rebase.rationale: GitHub rewrites commits; per-commit SHAs are not knowable pre-merge, but the expected resulting TREE can be computed and bound, with post-merge reconciliation of rewritten commit ids. MVP recommendation: recommendation-only OR supported-with-reconciliation; NOT exact-commit-SHA preauthorization.

merge_queue.authorization_treatment: the original PR DecisionRecord remains the binding decision, but a DERIVED authorization (new CER + ActionGovernanceRequest bound to the merge_group_sha) is required for the merge-group artifact

invalidation_rules.base_branch_advanced: INVALIDATE if merge base moved -> re-validate merge tree
invalidation_rules.merge_group_regenerated: INVALIDATE merge-group derived authorization -> re-validate + re-clear
